title: 第五章 不同的选择
content_zh:
“实力提升，越往后越难。”罗峰思忖着，“从秒速23.8米，增加到秒速25米。恐怕要一年时间。而拳力从809公斤，增加到900公斤，估计需要时间还要更长点。我想要获得‘武者’称号，估计要等进入大学之后了。”
“如果，如果……我再昏迷一次的话。我的身体素质，恐怕就能达到武者的要求了。”
当然，自己要的‘昏迷’，不是被人打得昏迷过去。而是头疼到极限，而昏迷过去。
罗峰有头疼的病症。
每天都会偶尔有一阵头疼，不过每次忍忍就过去了，而头疼到极限，就会昏迷！
从小到大，罗峰一共昏迷过两次。
八岁那年，弟弟被车压断了腿，那次罗峰伤心过度，突然觉得自己头非常的疼，同时心跳也快速的惊人，全身血液流转速度达到一个惊人的地步，感觉到自己心脏好像要从胸腔跳出来一样，直至承受不了直接昏迷。
还有十二岁那年，妈妈重病入院，害怕失去妈妈的罗峰，惊慌的很，同样头疼的要命，心跳速度惊人，再一次昏迷。
两次昏迷，家里人曾经带罗峰去医院检查，可根本查不出毛病。毕竟就算是现在，脑部依旧是医学上难以攻克的难题。
“不过，两次昏迷却诡异地让我身体素质都提高了一大截。”罗峰期待的很，“八岁，十二岁，这两次昏迷醒来后，我的力量、速度、神经反应明显强了很多。这才让我十六周岁刚进入武馆，就直接通过中级学员考核，获得‘中级学员’称号。正因为基础好，我十七周岁又获得‘高级学员’称号。”
“如果，我能再昏迷一次，实力肯定能再度跃升一次！”
昏迷，其实是身体的自我保护，并非完全是坏事。
罗峰从小就有头疼病，不过八岁那年第一次昏迷后，他就发现，每次头疼减轻了不少。等到十二岁那年，又一次昏迷之后。每次头疼又再度减轻。
“按照这样的趋势，我如果能再昏迷一次。头疼情况应该会再度减轻……昏迷个一两次，或许，头疼病就永远消失了。”罗峰心中渴望的很，毕竟昏迷一次，自己头疼病证就减轻。而且身体素质还会有一个跃迁。
可惜……
昏迷不是说，想昏迷就昏迷的。从小到大，也不过发生两次而已。
“头疼到极限，心跳速度也会快到极限。”
罗峰低头看了看手腕上的手表，这是一块含有‘测试脉搏’功能的手表。
“可是，就算极限奔跑，一分钟心跳也不超过120次。”罗峰看着手表，“如果我一分钟心跳，能达到两百多次，那多好。”昏迷前的征兆就是头非常疼、心跳非常快。
可惜――

不管运动如何剧烈，自己的心跳速度，也无法快到能头疼昏迷的地步。
※※※※※※
练武厅内，脸上有着刀疤的杨武，站在拳力测试机前。也没有认真蓄势，很随意的就是左右双拳猛烈的击打向拳靶，蓬！蓬！蓬！一连窜低沉的拳击声响起，拳力测试机的屏幕上流过一连窜的数字――“956kg，912kg，936kg，981kg……”
杨武一口气击打了数十拳这才停了下来。
旁边观看的罗峰，不由一阵羡慕，自己全力一拳也就809公斤。如果向杨哥这样连续迅速出拳，每一拳的力道能超过七百公斤就算不错了。
“杨哥，哪天我全力一拳，能有你这么随意一拳的力道。那就好了。”罗峰在一旁笑道。
“你小子。”杨武走过来，笑着一拍罗峰肩膀，“你今年才19岁，也就18周岁而已。你杨哥我像你这么大的时候，还只是武馆的中级学员呢。以你的进步速度……不要多，两年，绝对能达到武者的身体素质要求。啧啧……20周岁的武者，真是让人嫉妒啊。”
罗峰一笑。
武馆招收学员，是16周岁到30周岁，是因为这一个阶段成长最迅速。越早能跨入武者行列，代表以后实力会更强大。自己去年17周岁，就成为武馆高级学员。的确是让很多人羡慕。
“对了，疯子，你要高考了吧？准备高考后干什么？”杨武笑道。
“我准备考军校。”罗峰微微一笑，“一般军校收的学生，毕业后只是当普通军队的基层军官。而我，毕业后进入一些特种军队，应该不成问题。”
“哦。”
杨武听了撇撇嘴，“进军校好是好，不过……我感觉，就是人身自由受到限制了。等你将来军校毕业出来后，进入特种军队，在军队当中当然要服从军规！我反正是受不了，还是当一个自由武者比较好。”
“自由武者是不错。”罗峰摇头道，“不过，我不想让我爸妈担心。进入军校，毕业后进入军队。至少安全程度上，要比自由武者高很多。”
武者一般有四条路。
第一条路，加入军队，成为军队的一员。好处是安全性高，国家是不可能轻易让武者冒险的，国家也会给武者的家庭很多福利，让武者们没有后顾之忧。
第二条路，加入武馆。武馆管理制度比较宽松，属于比较松散的群体，而且极限武馆又是世界第一强者‘洪’创立，成为极限武馆的‘武者’后，好处不少，而且管理宽松，比较自由。
第三条路，加入某个集团财团，某个家族，某个大势力等等，属于当打手的那种。
第四条路，就是加入雇佣军，这是出生入死那种，最冒险，同时也是最自由的。
“进军队，安全是安全。不过，我是不想没什么自由的日子。”杨武摇头道，“今年，我估计就会再次去参加‘准武者考核’，应该能过关。一旦过关，我今年就会立即参加‘武者实战考核’，努力在今年成为一名武者。”

罗峰眼睛一亮：“杨哥，你有把握过准武者考核了？”
“哈哈。”杨武一笑，“三项素质测试，拳力和神经反应，我早达标了。我的弱项是速度！不过，现在我发挥好，也能勉强达到一秒25米。这些天再努力努力，到时候考核应该能过。”
“杨哥，恭喜啊。”罗峰为杨哥感到高兴，毕竟杨哥为了成为武者奋斗很多年了，“杨哥，你成为武者后，准备干什么？”
“当然是加入极限武馆。”杨武一笑，“极限武馆的制度很宽松，而且，武馆遍布全球各地，有很多武者前辈，对自己发展也有很多益处。而且，我可以想休息就休息，想出去猎杀怪兽就出去猎杀怪兽，多自由。”
罗峰点点头。
“疯子。”杨武看着罗峰，“你小子骨子里很疯狂的，我不会看走眼，我觉得你很适合走自由武者这条路。加入武馆，多自由？而且极限武馆，也会给我们很多帮助。”
“我……”罗峰有些迟疑。
杨武见状，摇头一笑：“疯子，自由武者经常出生入死，在生死间磨练。比较危险！可是同样，正因为经常在生死边缘厮杀，这实力进步也是最快的！你看看，不管什么地方，武者中的强者，绝大多数都是自由武者。”
※※※※※※
夜晚，路灯亮着。
离开极限武馆的罗峰，在人行道上独自一人默默走着，之前杨武和他说的一番话，的确影响不小。
“适合我的路，其实有两条。”罗峰心中默默道，“一条，是进入军校，顺顺当当的毕业，之后进入特种军队。第二条，是成为武者。加入极限武馆，成为极限武馆名下的武者，可以自由的去猎杀怪兽。”
“这两条路，第一条进入军校。安全性高、家庭福利好。就算战死，国家也会照顾好我的亲人。”
“第二条成为自由武者。经常生死间杀戮，实力提高快。猎杀怪兽也能换的巨额金钱，赚钱也快。这条路……危险、实力提高快、赚钱快、自由，唯一的缺点就是危险。”罗峰不断思考着，其实高三这一年来，他经常思考这一个问题。
“爸妈一共就两个儿子，弟弟已经残疾，如果我当自由武者，在生死厮杀中死了，爸妈后半辈子怎么办？”
弟弟是需要人照顾的。
爸妈岁数也大了，自己一死，爸妈怎么办？
“进军校吧。”
“将来进入特种军队，我也可以学习‘军中武道’，结合我在极限武馆学的‘极限武道’，实力应该能再度提升。在军队中，我一样可以磨练自己的实力！而且在军队中就算战死，作为武者身份战死，国家每个月也会发给我爸妈抚恤金的。”罗峰从为爸妈角度考虑，还是选择考军校。
只是……

军校，是罗峰想上就上的吗？一切就看六月份的高考了。
ps：罗峰的头疼病，是啥子原因呢？这是一个小坑……
啊，呼唤一下推荐票。
推荐票是多多益善啊，都砸给番茄吧
content_en:
"It becomes more difficult the further you go to improve your strength." Luo Feng thought, "I'm afraid it will take a year to increase from 23.8 meters per second to 25 meters per second. And the increase in boxing strength from 809 kilograms to 900 kilograms will probably take even longer. If I want to obtain the title of 'Martial Artist', I probably have to wait until I enter university."
"If, if...I fall into a coma again, my physical fitness will probably meet the requirements of a warrior."
Of course, the 'coma' I want is not to be beaten unconscious. Instead, he had a severe headache and passed out.
Luo Feng has a headache.
Occasionally I have a headache every day, but every time I endure it, it passes. When the headache reaches the extreme, I will fall into coma!
Since childhood, Luo Feng has been in coma twice.
When he was eight years old, his younger brother was crushed by a car and broke his leg. Luo Feng was overly sad that time and suddenly felt a severe pain in his head. At the same time, his heartbeat was extremely fast. The blood flow in his body reached an alarming rate. He felt as if his heart was about to jump out of his chest, until he couldn't bear it and fell into coma.
When he was twelve years old, his mother was seriously ill and was hospitalized. Luo Feng, who was afraid of losing his mother, was very panicked. He also had a terrible headache, his heartbeat was beating at an alarming rate, and he fell into coma again.
After falling into coma twice, his family took Luo Feng to the hospital for examination, but nothing could be found wrong. After all, even now, the brain is still an insurmountable problem in medicine.
"However, the two comas have strangely improved my physical fitness a lot." Luo Feng looked forward to it. "After waking up from these two comas at the age of eight and twelve, my strength, speed, and neurological reactions were significantly stronger. This is why I directly passed the intermediate student assessment when I entered the martial arts gym at the age of sixteen and was awarded the title of 'intermediate student'. Because of my good foundation, I was awarded the title of 'advanced student' when I was seventeen."
"If I can be unconscious again, my strength will definitely rise again!"
Coma is actually the body's self-protection and is not entirely a bad thing.
Luo Feng had suffered from headaches since he was a child, but after he fell into coma for the first time at the age of eight, he found that his headaches were relieved a lot each time. When I was twelve years old, I fell into coma again. Each time the headaches subsided again.
"According to this trend, if I can coma again, my headaches should be alleviated again... If I coma once or twice, maybe the headaches will disappear forever." Luo Feng was eager in his heart. After all, his headaches would be relieved once he was in coma. And there will be a leap in physical fitness.
What a pity...
Being in a coma does not mean that you can become comatose if you want to. It only happened twice since childhood.
"My headache is extremely severe and my heart rate is extremely fast."
Luo Feng lowered his head and looked at the watch on his wrist. This was a watch with a 'pulse test' function.
"But even if I run to the extreme, my heartbeat does not exceed 120 times a minute." Luo Feng looked at his watch. "It would be great if my heartbeat could reach more than 200 times a minute." The signs before coma are a very painful head and a very fast heartbeat.
It's a pity——
No matter how strenuous the exercise was, his heart rate could not be fast enough to cause him to suffer from a headache and pass out.
※※※※※※
In the martial arts training hall, Yang Wu, who had a scar on his face, stood in front of the boxing strength testing machine. He didn't prepare his momentum seriously, he just hit the target with his left and right fists casually, Peng! Peng! Peng! A series of low boxing sounds sounded, and a series of numbers flowed on the screen of the boxing strength testing machine - "956kg, 912kg, 936kg, 981kg..."
Yang Wu punched dozens of times before stopping.
Luo Feng, who was watching from the side, couldn't help but feel envious. One punch with his full strength only weighed 809 kilograms. If Xiang Ge Yang punches quickly and continuously like this, it would be good if the force of each punch exceeds 700 kilograms.
"Brother Yang, one day I will punch you with all my strength, to be able to have the power of a casual punch like yours. That would be great. Luo Feng said with a smile from the side.
"You boy. Yang Wu came over, smiled and patted Luo Feng on the shoulder, "You are only 19 years old this year, only 18 years old." When you, Brother Yang, and I were your age, we were only intermediate students in the martial arts school. At your rate of progress...it won't take more than two years, and you will definitely be able to meet the physical fitness requirements of a warrior. Tsk tsk... A 20-year-old warrior is really enviable. "
Luo Feng smiled.
Martial arts schools recruit students between the ages of 16 and 30 because they grow the fastest at this stage. The sooner you can step into the ranks of warriors, the more powerful you will be in the future. When he turned 17 last year, he became a senior student in the martial arts school. It is indeed the envy of many people.
"By the way, madman, are you going to take the college entrance examination? What to do after preparing for the college entrance examination? "Yang Wu said with a smile.
“I’m preparing to take the military academy entrance examination. Luo Feng smiled slightly, "Generally, students accepted by military academies only serve as junior officers in the ordinary army after graduation." As for me, it shouldn't be a problem to join some special forces after graduation. "
"oh. "
Yang Wu curled his lips after hearing this, "It's good to enter the military school, but... I feel that personal freedom is restricted. When you graduate from the military academy and join the special forces, of course you must obey military regulations in the army! I can't stand it anyway, so it's better to be a free warrior. "
“Freedom warriors are good. Luo Feng shook his head and said, "However, I don't want my parents to worry." Enter military school and enter the army after graduation. At least the safety level is much higher than that of free warriors. "
Warriors generally have four paths.
The first way is to join the army and become a member of the army. The advantage is that the security is high, and the state cannot easily let warriors take risks. The state will also provide many benefits to warriors' families, so that warriors have no worries.
The second way is to join a martial arts school. The management system of the martial arts gym is relatively loose, and it belongs to a relatively loose group. Moreover, the extreme martial arts gym was founded by Hong, the strongest person in the world. After becoming a "martial artist" in the extreme martial arts gym, there are many benefits, and the management is loose and relatively free.
The third way is to join a certain conglomerate, a certain family, a certain big force, etc., which is the kind of thug.
The fourth way is to join a mercenary army. This is the kind of life and death. It is the most risky and freest at the same time.
“In the army, safety is safety. However, I don’t want to live a life without any freedom. Yang Wu shook his head and said, "This year, I will probably take the 'Quasi Warrior Assessment' again, and I should be able to pass." Once I pass the test, I will immediately take part in the ‘Warrior Practical Assessment’ this year and strive to become a warrior this year. "
Luo Feng's eyes lit up: "Brother Yang, are you sure you have passed the quasi-martial artist assessment? "
"Ha ha. Yang Wu smiled and said, "I have already passed the three quality tests, boxing strength and neurological reaction." My weakness is speed! However, now that I perform well, I can barely reach 25 meters per second. If you work hard these days, you should be able to pass the test by then. "
"Brother Yang, congratulations. "Luo Feng was happy for Brother Yang. After all, Brother Yang had been struggling to become a warrior for many years. "Brother Yang, what are you going to do after you become a warrior? "
“Of course it’s to join the Extreme Martial Arts Gym. Yang Wu smiled, "The system of extreme martial arts schools is very relaxed. Moreover, martial arts schools are located all over the world. There are many senior martial artists, which is also beneficial to one's own development." Moreover, I can rest when I want, and go out and hunt monsters when I want. How free. "
Luo Feng nodded.
"Crazy. Yang Wu looked at Luo Feng, "You are crazy at heart. I won't let you go wrong. I think you are very suitable for taking the path of a free warrior." How free is it to join a martial arts gym? And the Extreme Martial Arts Gym will also give us a lot of help. "
"I..." Luo Feng hesitated.
Seeing this, Yang Wu shook his head and smiled: "Madman, free warriors often go through life and death.Trained between life and death. More dangerous! But again, precisely because they often fight on the edge of life and death, this strength is also the fastest to improve! Look, no matter where you are, most of the strongest warriors are free warriors. "
※※※※※※
At night, the street lights are on.
Luo Feng left the Ultimate Martial Arts Hall and walked alone and silently on the sidewalk. What Yang Wu said to him before had indeed had a considerable impact.
“There are actually two paths that suit me. Luo Feng said silently in his heart, "One is to enter the military academy, graduate smoothly, and then enter the special forces." The second rule is to become a warrior. Join the Extreme Martial Arts Hall and become a warrior under the name of the Extreme Martial Arts Hall. You can freely hunt monsters. "
“The first of these two paths is to enter the military academy. High security and good family welfare. Even if I die in battle, the country will take good care of my relatives. "
“Article 2: Become a free warrior. Frequent killing in life and death will increase your strength quickly. You can also get huge amounts of money by hunting monsters, and you can make money quickly. This road... is dangerous, can improve strength quickly, make money quickly, and is free. The only drawback is the danger. Luo Feng kept thinking. In fact, he had often thought about this issue during his senior year in high school.
"My parents have two sons in total. My younger brother is disabled. If I become a freedom warrior and die in a life-and-death fight, what will my parents do for the rest of their lives? "
My younger brother needs someone to take care of him.
My parents are getting older. What will my parents do if I die?
"Let's go to the military academy. "
"When I join the special forces in the future, I can also learn the 'Military Martial Arts'. Combined with the 'Extreme Martial Arts' I learned at the Extreme Martial Arts School, my strength should be improved again. In the army, I can also hone my strength! And even if I die in the army, as a warrior, the country will give my parents a pension every month. "Luo Feng considered taking the military academy entrance exam for his parents' sake.
Just...
Did Luo Feng go to the military academy if he wanted to? Everything depends on the college entrance examination in June.
